BiblicalUsage: Plasma is a thing formed, what the potter has moulded. Paul uses it once, in Romans 9:20: shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the clay has no case against the potter, and my questions do not outrank His right.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
